text.tspan: The borrowed bench and the stairs
A relational layout of competing kinds of care, not a measured map.
A shared work surface in the
Stops cutting when the pigeon beats at the
Drags one wing over a rag
Works at the end of the borrowed bench
F · The father on the stairs
Stops; the mender stops two steps below
B > A: lends space / B > C: feeds and attends / D > A: uses one end / D > E: points it out to father / D > F: follows with the prayer
Shelter for the mender and pigeon coexists with the father's unanswered demand to receive his property.
